rules.affine_border: constant per-original-image channel-wise median; grid-constant bilinear interpolation
rules.aggregation: mean within evaluable family, then equal mean across evaluable families
rules.blur: scipy gaussian_filter sigma=(0.6,0.6,0), reflect boundary, truncate=4.0; no channel mixing
rules.contrast: single scalar mean over all original pixels and channels
rules.coordinates: xy edge coordinates; pixel centres (column+0.5,row+0.5); image bounds [0,width] x [0,height]
rules.matching: class-agnostic IoU>=0.50; maximise cardinality then total polygon IoU
rules.rotation: positive counterclockwise visually, centre (width/2,height/2); unchanged canvas
rules.ties: source reference order; transformed detections sorted by xyxy then detector index; deterministic SciPy assignment; no class/confidence tie weights
